```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
source(here::here("00_R", "simulate_shots.R"))
source(here::here("00_R", "simulate_shots_sbc.R"))
source(here::here("00_R", "simulate_shots_sbc_2.R"))
```

First we generate 1,000 synthetic observations using our simulate_l2m function

```{r}
synthetic_data <- simulate_nba_shots_sbc( 
   n_observations = 1000,
   n_defenders = 30,
   n_teams = 6,
   seed = 123
   )

synthetic_df <- synthetic_data$generated

```

Now we define a model formula using brms.

```{r}
# Define the model formula
foul_binomial_formula <- bf(
  shots_made | trials(shots_taken) ~ 
    1 + defender_foul_count +
    (1 + defender_foul_count | shot_distance_category) +
    (1 + defender_foul_count | team_id) +
    (1 + defender_foul_count | position)
)

# Set priors
foul_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),  # Fixed effects
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "sd"),  # Random effect standard deviations
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")  # Random effect correlations
)

foul_priors_2 <- c(

  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),  # Fixed effects
  
  # Random effects using exponential prior for SD
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  
  # Keeping current LKJ prior for correlations
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")
)

foul_priors_3 <- c(
  # Intercept: Shot-making probability
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  
  # Defender foul count effect
  # We expect this to have a moderate effect, likely positive
  prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "defender_foul_count"),
  
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")
)

# Perform prior predictive checks
prior_check_model <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula,
  data = synthetic_df,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = foul_priors_3,
  sample_prior = "only",  # Only sample from priors
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)

# Plot prior predictive distributions
prior_predictions <- posterior_predict(prior_check_model) 
prior_means <- colMeans(prior_predictions)

# Create a data frame for plotting
prior_plot_data <- data.frame(
  observed = synthetic_df$shots_made,
  predicted = prior_means,
  position = synthetic_df$position
)

# Plot prior predictions vs observed
ggplot(prior_plot_data, aes(x = observed, y = predicted, color = position)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Prior Predictive Check",
       x = "Observed Shots Made",
       y = "Predicted Shots Made") +
  theme_minimal()

# Check prior distributions of key parameters
prior_draws <- as_draws_df(prior_check_model)

# Plot prior distributions for fixed effects
ggplot(prior_draws, aes(x = b_defender_foul_count)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Prior Distribution: Defender Foul Count Effect",
       x = "Effect Size",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot prior distributions for random effect standard deviations
ggplot(prior_draws, aes(x = sd_position__Intercept)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Prior Distribution: Position Random Effect SD",
       x = "Standard Deviation",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
default_priors <- default_prior(foul_binomial_model)

# Fit the model
foul_binomial_model_default <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula,
  data = synthetic_df,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)

default_priors <- default_prior(foul_binomial_model_default)

# Check model summary
summary(foul_binomial_model_default)

# Check model diagnostics
plot(foul_binomial_model_default)

# Posterior predictive checks
pp_check(foul_binomial_model, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)

```

```{r}
library(SBC)

generator <- SBC_generator_brms(formula = foul_binomial_formula, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = synthetic_df, prior = foul_priors_2, backend = "cmdstanr", 
                                thin = 50, warmup = 10000, refresh = 2000,
                                out_stan_file = file.path("05-1_models/brms_generator_3.stan")
                                )

set.seed(42)

datasets <- generate_datasets(generator, 500)

prior_sd <- calculate_prior_sd(datasets)

backend <- SBC_backend_brms_from_generator(generator, chains = 1, thin = 1,
                            warmup = 500, iter = 1500,               
                            inits = 0.1)

results_500 <- compute_SBC(datasets, backend,
                    cache_mode = "results", 
                    cache_location = file.path("second"))

plot_rank_hist(results_500)

plot_ecdf_diff(results_500)

hist(results_100$stats$rhat)

hist(results_100$stats$ess_bulk)

hist(results_100$stats$z_score)

z_score_results_100 <- results_100$stats$z_score

z_score_results_500 <- results_500$stats$z_score

contraction_result_100 <- 1 - (results_100$stats$sd / prior_sd)**2

contraction_result_500 <- 1 - (results_500$stats$sd / prior_sd)**2


plot(results_500, z_score_results_500, col=c("#8F272720"), lwd=2, pch=16, cex=0.8,
     xlim=c(0, 1), xlab="Posterior Contraction",
     ylim=c(-5, 5), ylab="Posterior z-Score")



```

```{r}

generator_2 <- SBC_generator_function(simulate_nba_shots_sbc,
                                      n_observations = 1000,
                                      n_defenders = 30,
                                      n_teams = 6)

datasets_func <- generate_datasets(generator_2, 10)

backend_func <- SBC_backend_brms(formula = foul_binomial_formula, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                      backend = "cmdstanr", prior = foul_priors_2, chains = 1,
                      template_data = datasets_func$generated[[1]],
                      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
                      out_stan_file = file.path("05-1_models/brms_backend_3.stan"))

results_func <- compute_SBC(datasets_func, backend_func,
                    cache_mode = "results", 
                    cache_location = file.path("fourth"))

plot_rank_hist(results_func)

plot_ecdf_diff(results_func)

datasets_func_100 <- generate_datasets(generator_2, 100)

results_func_100 <- compute_SBC(datasets_func, backend_func,
                    cache_mode = "results", 
                    cache_location = file.path("fifth"))

plot_rank_hist(results_func_100)


```
